sections.lever checks:
- Family and target: q01's stack (aq-06835 i02: Too easy at High 4/6, one solver missing twice, the only stack the High model has missed on this bundle) applied to Stryker: a period no release reports used to select and to compute, with the answer on the other basis (adjusted selection, reported answer) and two decimals. Target hard. Sentence and answer carried word for word from sketch i10 (origin claude, 2026-10-18). Local strong-solver screen on this exact sentence: 3/3 right at high confidence (notes/sketches/i10.md; ledger row 92). User quick test against the High model: failed (2026-10-19, "all too easy"); written up at the user's request ("go on option 1", 2026-10-19) for a difficulty run, since a quick test is one try and a Too easy run was refunded on q01 ("Too easy, so you got an extra run"). Platform difficulty result pending.
- Dependency plan: Doc 1 (D06) supplies full-year and fourth-quarter 2025 net sales, reported operating income and adjusted gross profit; Doc 3 (D05) supplies the second-quarter and six-month 2025 figures. Third quarter = full year - fourth quarter - first half on each line; selection on adjusted gross profit margin (Q3 64.93 < Q4 65.25 < Q2 65.33 < Q1 65.55); answer on reported operating income / net sales.
- Universe: the four calendar quarters of 2025 (Stryker's year ends December 31, Doc 1 "For the Three Months and Full Year December 31"). Q1 2026's 63.6% is outside "2025 quarter".
- Necessity: D06 is the only source of full-year and fourth-quarter 2025 figures (searched "16,391", "25,116", "4,889", "4,679": D06 only). D05 is the only source of second-quarter and six-month 2025 figures ("7,779", "11,888", "1,950", "3,934": D05 only). D04 (Q1 2025: 3,845 / 5,866) is replaceable by D05's six months less Q2 and by the first-half average argument in Step 11, so it is not ticked or used. Delete-and-guess: without D06, Q1 and Q2 only; Q2 is lower (65.33) -> 18.48%; without D05, Q1 (D04) and Q4 (D06) known, Q4 wins -> 25.16%; neither is the gold.
- Selected-lever checks: period no release reports: missing the derived quarter gives Q4, 1,804 / 7,171 = 25.16%. Look-alike metric: answering with Q3's adjusted operating income margin gives (6,603 - 2,164 - 2,889) / 6,057 = 25.59%. Recomputed in scratchpad calc_aq06835_r3.py. A side mismatch: Doc 3 prints Q2 2025's adjusted gross profit margin as 65.4% although its dollars give 65.33%; either way Q2 is above Q4 and Q3, so the selection does not change.
- Targeted failure modes: declared Figure that must be computed / Uses the wrong period or date -> 25.16% (the lazy default: Q4's printed 65.2% at D06 l.281 is the lowest printed 2025 adjusted gross profit margin). Not declared: 25.59% (adjusted basis), which "reported operating income margin" rules out.
- Calculation verification: script recomputation gives Q3 sales 6,057, adjusted gross profit 3,933, operating income 1,135, margin 18.7386% -> 18.74%. Cross-checks: D04 Q1 + D05 Q2 equal D05's six months (sales 5,866 + 6,022 = 11,888, adjusted gross profit 3,845 + 3,934 = 7,779, operating income 837 + 1,113 = 1,950); Q3 operating expenses 11,176 - 2,824 - 5,635 = 2,717 and gross profit 3,852 - 2,717 = 1,135. Units $ millions; percentages from the dollar figures.
- Semantic/ID/overview probes: no Stryker release prints a third-quarter 2025 figure ("third quarter", "September", "nine months": no Stryker hits). Shortest complete route: two documents, six subtractions, five divisions and a comparison.
- Precision/readings: printed figures give 18.7386 -> 18.74 by every route; input-rounding bounds 18.709-18.768, as with q01 the printed figures fix the gold. "Reported" = GAAP (D06 l.63 "Reported gross profit margin and reported operating income margin"). Selection robust under input rounding (Q3 at most 64.974 vs Q4 at least 65.237).
- Completeness: capture complete (9 of 9 documents, no gap characters); D04-D06 statements and reconciliations read in full.

sections.question: For Stryker's 2025 quarter with the lowest adjusted gross profit margin, what was its reported operating income margin? Give the percentage to two decimal places.
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Source input (Doc 1, consolidated statements of earnings, three months and full year ended December 31, 2025): net sales 7,171 (fourth quarter) and 25,116 (full year); operating income 1,804 (fourth quarter) and 4,889 (full year) ($ millions).
Step 2. Source input (Doc 1, reconciliation of non-GAAP measures, three months and full year 2025): adjusted gross profit 4,679 (fourth quarter) and 16,391 (full year) ($ millions).
Step 3. Source input (Doc 3, consolidated statements of earnings, three and six months ended June 30, 2025): net sales 6,022 (second quarter) and 11,888 (six months); operating income 1,950 (six months) ($ millions).
Step 4. Source input (Doc 3, reconciliation of non-GAAP measures, three and six months 2025): adjusted gross profit 3,934 (second quarter) and 7,779 (six months) ($ millions).
Step 5. Calculation (Doc 1): fourth-quarter 2025 adjusted gross profit margin = 4,679 / 7,171 = 65.25%.
Step 6. Calculation (Doc 3): second-quarter 2025 adjusted gross profit margin = 3,934 / 6,022 = 65.33%.
Step 7. Calculation (Doc 3): first-half 2025 adjusted gross profit margin = 7,779 / 11,888 = 65.44%.
Step 8. Calculation (Doc 1 and Doc 3): third-quarter 2025 adjusted gross profit, full year less fourth quarter less first half = 16,391 - 4,679 - 7,779 = 3,933 ($ millions).
Step 9. Calculation (Doc 1 and Doc 3): third-quarter 2025 net sales = 25,116 - 7,171 - 11,888 = 6,057 ($ millions).
Step 10. Calculation (Doc 1 and Doc 3): third-quarter 2025 adjusted gross profit margin = 3,933 / 6,057 = 64.93%.
Step 11. Comparison (Doc 1 and Doc 3): the second quarter's 65.33% is below the first-half 65.44%, so the first quarter's margin is above 65.44%. The third quarter's 64.93% is below that, below the second quarter's 65.33% and below the fourth quarter's 65.25%, so the third quarter of 2025 has the lowest adjusted gross profit margin.
Step 12. Calculation (Doc 1 and Doc 3): third-quarter 2025 operating income as reported = 4,889 - 1,804 - 1,950 = 1,135 ($ millions).
Step 13. Calculation (Doc 1 and Doc 3): third-quarter 2025 reported operating income margin = 1,135 / 6,057 = 18.74%, rounded as the question asks.
sections.targeted failure modes:
### Failure mode 1
Trap: Figure that must be computed
How a careless solver fails: Uses the wrong period or date

Why these are traps: Doc 1 prints a 65.2% fourth-quarter 2025 adjusted gross profit margin, the lowest any release prints for 2025, so a careless solver picks the fourth quarter and answers 25.16%. The third quarter, printed nowhere, is full year less first half (Doc 3) less fourth quarter: 64.93%, lower, so 18.74%.
